author: Laszzlo
body:
Hey!

Artemis is a team for emerging players who aspire to become a great competitive player one day. This team welcomes players in all shapes and sizes, aiming for a broad roster of friendly, team players. We wish to actively scrim a variety of gamemodes and experiment with the positions you play in.

Requirements:
Must be able to speak English to an understandable degree.
Must be able to make scrimmages in GMT preferred times.
Must be able to use Slack as the communication service.
Must be able to use TeamSpeak.

Application format:
Skype:
Position:
Timezone:
Honest strengths:
Honest weaknesses:
What makes you want to join Artemis?:
Any further comments you'd like to say?:

Myself or LineCannon will contact you on Skype and give you details on how to join Slack.

DISCLAIMER: Artemis has no connection to Apollo and you are not in a trial for Apollo, you are playing for Artemis.
